pages.text: An I/O crystal attaches to the face of the block you place it on: a machine, a cable, a generator or a pylon. $(l)Shift-right-click$() it with an empty hand to switch mode:$(li)$(3)Input from Block$(): accepts energy the block pushes into it. Use this on generators and on pylons set to output.$(li)$(6)Output to Block$(): pushes network energy into the block.
An input crystal does not pull. The block it sits on has to push energy out.

pages.title: Links
pages.text: $(li)Basic: 2 links$(li)Wyvern: 3 links$(li)Draconic: 4 links$(br2)With so few links, I/O crystals are usually linked to a relay crystal rather than to each other.$(br2)One relay crystal crafts into two I/O crystals of the same tier, and two I/O crystals craft back into one relay.
